full_judgment:
7. One thing at the outset strikes us is that the informant who was not an eye-witness reported the assault learning from PWs 2, 3, 4, and 8, but without description and in the witness-box the witnesses gave photographic picturised account of the assault which cannot be expected in the cases like the instant case from the witnesses, if they were not tutored or sat in a class prior to their deposition in the witness-box. But in such a situation we think a Court should not throw the whole case. A Court should endeavor to separate the grain from the chaff instead of taking the easy course of rejecting the entire prosecution case. 

 15. We further hold that the accusation that Hillal Hossain injured PW 2. Safatullah has not been proved to the hilt, but the accusation that Abdul Jalil injured PW 4 Nurul Islam has been well-proved in view of the corroborative evidence of the doctor PW 14 who examined him. 

 16. So far the accusation against appellant No.11 Feroj is concerned it has been well-proved that he struck on the back of the deceased by a cycle chain. but the injury caused by him was not found at the time of post mortem examination. Learned Assistant Attorney-General points out that such injury was found at the time of inquest of the dead body. So we find that the injury caused by Feroj was so minor that it disappeared at the time of post mortem examination. We do not, therefore, like to convict him on this count. 

 In the result this appeal relating to appellant No.1 Masum is dismissed. This appeal relating to appellant No. 14 Abdul Jalil also dismissed with the modification in the sentence to the effect that his sentence of RI for 2 years is altered to RI for the period he had already served out. This appeal relating to the other appellants is allowed and they are found not guilty to the charge and are acquitted thereof. Appellant Nos. (2) Abdul Halim, (3) Abdullah, (4) Nurul Mallik, (5) Mizarul, (6) Maula alias Matiul, (7) Rabiul Islam; (8) Abdus Sattar, (9) Tofazzal Hossain, (10) Bhulu alias Golam Kibria, (11) Feroj, (12) Parul alias Abdul Majid and (13) Yeas in Mia must be set at liberty at once, if not wanted in any other case. Appellant No.14 Abdul Jalil and appellant No.15 Hillal Hossain are discharged from their respective bail bond.
